description: Is this exact package version affected by a published advisory? Queries OSV (GitHub Advisory Database, PyPA, and more) for the version and returns status (affected or not_affected_by_queried_advisories), every advisory with aliases (CVE), summary, severity, the affected ranges as published, fixed versions and references. The version is checked against the registry first; no advisory is never reported as safe. Price: 0.005 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"deps_check_advisories"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/deps/check?ecosystem=npm&name=lodash&version=4.17.15
name: deps_check_advisories
title: YRUZ DependencyPulse Advisory Check (0.005 USDC)
